# The Wicked Queen

## Definition
The Wicked Queen is the primary antagonist in the fairy tale "Snow White," representing the darker aspects of human nature, particularly vanity and jealousy. Her obsession with being the fairest in the land drives her to commit heinous acts against her stepdaughter, Snow White.

## Key Characteristics
- Embodies themes of vanity and jealousy.
- Utilizes dark magic and deception to achieve her goals.
- Portrayed as a beautiful yet malevolent figure.
- Ultimately meets her demise due to her own malicious actions.
- Represents the archetype of the evil stepmother in fairy tales.

## Context
The Wicked Queen serves as a cautionary figure within the broader context of fairy tales, illustrating the consequences of unchecked vanity and jealousy. Her character highlights the moral lessons often found in folklore, where good ultimately triumphs over evil, reinforcing the values of kindness and humility.
